repos_data.description: 💰 Ocular - A fancy, simplistic, beautiful and straight-forward, open-source budgeting tracking app to track your budget across the years. Easy to use, to get started and to set up.
Econumo - A personal and family budgeting app with multi-currency support, shared accounts, and flexible budgets
MyFin Budget - Rest API for the personal finances platform that'll help you budget, keep track of your income/spending and forecast your financial future.
